name: TypeScript review baseline
description: Type safety, narrowing, module boundaries, and testing guidance for TypeScript projects.

rules.title: External data is narrowed safely
rules.rationale: Static types do not validate data arriving at runtime.
check_statements: Untrusted data is validated or narrowed before use.
Changed boundaries do not introduce unjustified any-like escapes.

rules.title: Changed runtime behaviour is tested
rules.rationale: Compile-time checks and runtime tests cover different failure modes.
check_statements: Type checks remain part of CI.
